title: policy_risk
description: An insurable object as insured under a policy (a risk unit): the vehicle on an auto policy, the building at a location, the insured life, the operations of a business in a state. Supertype for line-specific rating detail.

risk_number.description: Stable number of the risk on the policy (vehicle 1, building 2); unchanged across versions.

rating_jurisdiction_code.description: State the risk is rated and reported in; may differ from the governing state on multi-state policies.

insured_value_amount.description: Total insured value or stated amount, where applicable.

additional_attributes.description: Policy-specific rating characteristics with no dedicated subtype entity.

effective_date.description: First business date this row applies.

expiration_date.description: Business date this row stops applying (exclusive); null while open-ended.

added_by_transaction_id.description: Policy transaction that introduced this row.

removed_by_transaction_id.description: Policy transaction that removed or superseded this row.
